---
title: element-rect
subtitle: "Rectangle element: fill and stroke."
category: Themes
since: 0.1.0
engine: markdown
---


Pass the result to [`theme`](theme.qmd) under keys like `panel-background`.

## Usage

```typst
element-rect(
  fill: none,
  stroke: none,
)
```


## Parameters

| Parameter | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fill` | `none` | Rectangle fill colour, or `none` to inherit. |
| `stroke` | `none` | Rectangle stroke, or `none` to inherit. |

## Returns

Element dictionary consumed by [`theme`](theme.qmd).

## Examples

```{typst}
//| output-filename: "/assets/typst-render/element-rect-1.svg"
//| width: 10cm
//| height: 6cm
#let d = range(0, 10).map(i => (x: i, y: i * 0.5))
#plot(
  data: d,
  mapping: aes(x: "x", y: "y"),
  layers: (geom-point(size: 2pt),),
  theme: theme(panel-background: element-rect(fill: rgb("#f7f0e7"))),
)
```
